previousRule: WELCOME5, personal 10% offer and sample-credit checkout derived mixed-cart persistence keys from stable review or reservation data. Fresh guest attempts with the same cart could reuse a globally unique group key under a different owner, causing a 409 database conflict.
newRule: All three discounted mixed-cart paths include the browser's random order attempt in the derived persistence key. Repeating one attempt remains idempotent; a new guest attempt with the same configuration gets a distinct group. Offer and credit reservation identifiers retain their existing eligibility semantics.
reason: After the first checkout-key fix went live, a fresh-browser WELCOME5 checkout still failed. Production Supabase logged a duplicate cushion_checkout_groups primary key on commit_cushion_checkout. The other discounted paths shared the same key-scoping risk. This follow-up prevents cross-attempt collisions without changing discounts or stock checks.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner requested complete checkout reliability and posted the exact-head approval for the preceding hotfix. This new protected change requires a new Nylon1 exact-current-head comment before merge or production deployment.
